title: CRESt: A multimodal robotic platform for multi-element electrocatalyst discovery
text: Curated method summary: CRESt combines composition and text knowledge, microstructural observations, knowledge-assisted Bayesian optimization, and experimental automation. The transferable design idea is to link knowledge retrieval, adaptive experiment selection and returned observations. The SACFactory adaptation is a proposal, not a reproduction of CRESt performance.

title: Closed-loop transfer enables artificial intelligence to yield chemical knowledge
text: Curated method summary: closed-loop experimentation is combined with physics-based feature selection and supervised learning. Predictions motivate targeted experimental tests of chemical hypotheses. For SAC synthesis, an analogous test changes controlled cutoff temperature or pulse count while holding the precursor recipe fixed; an association alone is not a causal result.

title: An autonomous laboratory for the accelerated synthesis of inorganic materials
text: Curated method summary: A-Lab combines literature-derived synthesis proposals, thermodynamic guidance, active learning and returned characterization. Failed attempts inform revised routes. XRD phase inference in crystalline powders is a distinct task from proving atomic dispersion in supported catalysts.

title: Machine-learning-assisted materials discovery using failed experiments
text: Curated method summary: unsuccessful experiments can carry useful supervised information. Preserve chemical failures as outcomes; distinguish missing measurements and equipment or handling failures. A correct forecast of structural FAIL is useful prediction and does not become a successful material.

title: SACFactory quantity and measurement definitions
text: Precursor amount n in mmol equals concentration in mM times solvent volume in mL divided by 1000. At 20 mL DMF, 1 mmol equals 50 mM. Default PAN mass is 2 g. ICP W is numerical wt%: 2.5 means 2.5 wt%. Controlled cutoff is a setting. Constant 32 V and 80 A without a pulse-duration trace do not determine pulse energy. ICP content and an XRD/STEM PASS assessment are distinct outcomes.
